name: Youngor Fashion Co., Ltd.
summary: Youngor Fashion Co., Ltd. engages in the clothing and real estate development business in China and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Investment, Real Estate/Tourism, Apparel, and Textiles. It offers worsted wool fabrics and semi-worsted tweed; hemp yarn, fabric, hemp fiber wallpaper, hemp wallcovering, wool fabric wallcoverings, and hemp fiber fabrics; and shirts, suits, jackets, pants, tops, and other products.
